scope: Structural basis of pulmonary gas exchange and ventilation-perfusion matching.

keyRecommendations.text: In the normal lung, correlated airway and vascular branching creates well-matched VA/Q distributions; active matching is invoked mostly under perturbed conditions.
The acinus is described as the basic unit of gas exchange.
Hypoxic pulmonary vasoconstriction preserves ventilation-perfusion matching after lung resection but also limits the compensatory rise in capillary blood volume.

clinicalBottomLine: This review teaches V/Q matching as a structural property of the normal lung, with active mechanisms such as hypoxic vasoconstriction used mainly when matching is disturbed.
notableCaveats: Classic textbook zone numbers were not taken from this paper and are not used in the questions.
